backward SS forgets the remaining duration of the predecessor
backward FF bounds by the successor late start instead of its late finish

summaries counted in overall / planned

find: IF NOT is_sum[i] AND NOT done[i] AND endd[i] IS NOT NULL

name: a summary is part of the forecast end
find:
WHERE sched[g.ix] AND NOT is_sum[g.ix];
  v_deadline
reason: a summary is only scheduled when some kid is, and deriveFwd then sets its end to the latest kid end, so it can never exceed the leaves: the forecast is identical

name: parent cycle cut at the wrong edge
find: IF nx = ANY (seen) THEN par[k] := 0; EXIT; END IF;
replace: IF nx = ANY (seen) THEN par[i] := 0; EXIT; END IF;

name: SS into a summary is ignored like a finish-bound link
find: IF is_sum[t] AND ty NOT IN ('FS', 'SS') THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
replace: IF is_sum[t] AND ty NOT IN ('FS') THEN CONTINUE; END IF;

name: FF into a summary is applied to its leaves
find: IF is_sum[t] AND ty NOT IN ('FS', 'SS') THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
replace: IF is_sum[t] AND ty NOT IN ('FS', 'SS', 'FF') THEN CONTINUE; END IF;

name: backward: FF from a summary predecessor ignored
find: IF is_sum[p] AND ty NOT IN ('FS', 'FF') THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
replace: IF is_sum[p] AND ty NOT IN ('FS') THEN CONTINUE; END IF;

name: summaries not processed deepest first
a summary is never done (all-kids-done rule dropped)
reason: a done summary only matters as a link endpoint; as successor ls[t] is NULL (no incomplete kid) and is skipped, as predecessor every target leaf is done and skipped: identical output

name: a summary is scheduled even when no kid is
the parent column is ignored (no hierarchy at all)
find: IF k IS NOT NULL AND k <> i THEN par[i] := k; END IF;
replace: IF FALSE THEN par[i] := k; END IF;

name: a pass that does not settle raises instead of stopping
find: IF pass > n + 1 THEN EXIT; END IF;
replace: IF pass > n + 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dependency cycle in job %', p_job_id; END IF;

name: summary leaf targets include nested summaries
find: IF is_sum[c] THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
replace: IF FALSE THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
reason: a nested summary hit as a target has its es/ef re-derived from its kids at the start of the next pass, so only wasted passes change, never a leaf or the output

name: undated link participants no longer scheduled (Phase A rule)
find: IF NOT (done[t] AND endd[t] IS NULL) THEN sched[t] := true; END IF;
